W5 (compiler boundary): in the merged src/web/compiler/index.ts, git.ts and privacy.ts, the only `.claude` hit is the line 1 comment. There is no http, fetch, process.env or other network access. git.ts makes only read-only calls (rev-parse, ls-tree, cat-file, log, show) through execFileSync with an argument array, so there is no shell injection. resolveRef rejects a ref that starts with '-'. Every file the merge combined passes through read(), which scans the whole text and pushes fatal problems. The merged read set is harness.json, dag.yaml, requirements and matrices, activity, loop, verdicts, findings, README, walkthrough, investigation plans and the docs/context snapshots. The patch of every node commit is scanned (line 319), as are test names, commit subjects and every trailer value, and `fail(fatal)` at line 399 runs before any write. The U3 blocks (decisions, findings, events, verdicts, places) and the U5 sessions block (CTX-1) sit side by side with no duplicated or dropped scan. The compiler denylist problems from the failure paths name no matched text.

W5 (denylist intact): docs/trace/privacy-denylist.txt still holds the absolute-path, email and key/token patterns with the same allows. The merge did not weaken them. The working-tree edit to this file is uncommitted and is not part of HEAD.

W1: no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML, outerHTML, insertAdjacentHTML, document.write, eval or new Function anywhere under src/web. The only hits are comments in MarkdownText.tsx saying it avoids them and refuses javascript:, data:, vbscript: and file:. No conflict markers remain in src/web.

W2: the merged About.tsx tour hrefs are all hash routes starting with `#/`, built from trace.rules, trace.nodes and commit.sha, with the rule id through encodeURIComponent. A data value cannot become a `javascript:` URL. The external links in app/ go through repo.ts, which builds them from the fixed REPO constant and a sha, path or PR number, with rel=noreferrer on the Matrix and Rule links. The Frame.tsx footer links are `${REPO}/commit/${sha}` and `#/about`.

The browser and Playwright scratch output should stay out of git, and `git add` is explicit by path.
